name: 30-second chair stand
rangeNote: A fitness test, so there is no lab range: your result is compared with people of your age and sex in published norm tables (shown on this page).
summary: How many times you can stand up fully from a chair and sit back down in 30 seconds, without using your arms. It reflects leg strength and endurance. More is better.

high.meaning: More stands in 30 seconds for your age means stronger legs.

low.meaning: Fewer stands in 30 seconds for your age means weaker legs, which matters for getting up, climbing stairs and avoiding falls.
